name: Shukure no Tonari
source:
On a Sunday afternoon, just before Christmas.
Here at the Western confectionery shop Sucre, business is booming as Christmas cakes fly off the shelves.

“Welcome~! Would you like a Christmas cake?”

A classic shoujo-manga-style otome game where you’re pursued by a baby-faced onee!

Note: The love interest is an onee, but he’s heterosexual. It’s really just his way of speaking.
translation:
圣诞节前的某个星期天下午。
西点店Sucre里，圣诞蛋糕卖得火热，生意一片兴隆。

“欢迎光临～！要来一份圣诞蛋糕吗？”

一款经典少女漫画风格的乙女游戏，追求你的，是个娃娃脸、说话带着大姐范儿的男人！

注意：攻略对象虽然说话举止女性化，但性取向是异性恋，只是说话方式如此。
